summary: Added RefusedRunDelivery (extends CompletedRunDelivery, deliver() pushes to asked then rejects with RunDeliveryFailure(REFUSAL)) to run-delivery-double.ts, and two in-process tests to restart-recovery.test.ts: a read (recovery.inspect()) that neither starts nor waits for a publication (proved by a CompletedRunDelivery whose deliver() never settles, overridden via Object.assign following the existing test-double idiom), and a two-tick recover() sequence showing a refused publication is attempted exactly once and then surfaces as an uncertain plan with action continue and the refusal diagnostic. Both mutation-tested by hand (starting delivery during a read, and flipping the recovery action) and confirmed red then restored clean. npm run typecheck and the targeted vitest run (restart-recovery.test.ts + process-ratchet.test.ts, 10 tests) both pass; no production code changed.
